shadowCrowdRadius.description: The boot soft-shadow crowd radius (world units).

upscaleSharpness.description: The boot reduced-resolution reconstruction blend (0 bilinear .. 1 Catmull-Rom).

lighting.description: The scene's directional sun and ambient term. Optional, and every field within it is optional individually — an absent section, or an absent field within it, resolves to SdfFrame's pinned default for that field, so a world renders unchanged until it authors one.

lights.description: The lights, at most SdfLighting.MaxLights, in slot order. Section keys address an existing row by its authored name. At most one directional may shadow: the soft-shadow march runs once per lit pixel.

items.description: One light. The $type string is the JSON discriminator; a new kind is a new derived record, its JsonDerivedTypeAttribute line, and its resolved values in SdfLighting.

direction.description: The direction from a lit surface toward the light, any nonzero length (normalized host-side before upload). Absent is the pinned sun direction.

weight.description: The diffuse weight. Absent is the pinned sun weight.

angularRadius.description: The light's angular radius in radians, in [0, atan 0.3]: the penumbra half-slope is its tangent, so 0 casts a hard shadow. Read only when the light shadows. Absent is the pinned penumbra.
angularRadius.title: BindableAngle

shadows.description: Whether this light drives the soft-shadow march (at most one light per world). Absent is false. An unshadowed directional is scaled by ambient occlusion instead.

name.description: The authored row identity used by section keys and source-preserving edits.

anyOf.description: A hemisphere ambient: a floor plus a gradient on the surface normal's Y (sky above, darker below), scaled by ambient occlusion.

base.description: The floor. Absent is the pinned ambient floor.

gradient.description: The hemisphere gradient. Absent is the pinned gradient.

name.description: The authored row identity used by section keys and source-preserving edits.

anyOf.title: WorldRenderLightHemisphere

anyOf.description: A view-dependent silhouette brighten: weight · color · pow(1 − saturate(dot(normal, −rayDirection)), power), added after the material shade.

weight.description: The strength. Absent is zero, which adds nothing.

power.description: The falloff exponent — larger confines the highlight nearer the silhouette. Absent is the engine default.

name.description: The authored row identity used by section keys and source-preserving edits.

anyOf.title: WorldRenderLightRim

anyOf.description: A point light with inverse-square falloff and a soft core: intensity = weight / (1 + (distance / radius)^2). No shadow march in v1 — a point light never occludes and is never occluded.

position.description: The world-space position for a static (unanchored) light. Absent is the world origin. An offset in the anchor frame when an anchor is authored.

radius.description: The falloff radius. Absent is the engine default.

anchor.description: An entity, entity part, or placement frame. A missing live target disables the light.

weight.description: The strength. Absent is the engine default.

name.description: The authored row identity used by section keys and source-preserving edits.

anyOf.title: WorldRenderLightPoint

anyOf.description: A smooth attenuation field. Position is world space, or an offset in an anchored entity/part/placement frame. Missing anchors disable it. Radius is positive; Weight is in [0, 1]. It shares the eight-light capacity.

name.description: The authored row identity used by section keys and source-preserving edits.

anyOf.title: WorldRenderLightOccluder

items.title: WorldRenderLight

curvature.description: The stylized curvature enrichment — cavity darkening, curvature rim light, and an ink outline. Optional; absent (and all-zero) shades exactly as a world that declares none.

cavity.description: How far a concave crease darkens, in [0, 1] at a cavity whose curvature reaches InkLow. Zero darkens none.

rim.description: How far a convex ridge brightens, in [0, 1] at a ridge whose curvature reaches InkLow. Zero brightens none.

ink.description: The ink outline's strength where the curvature magnitude spikes. Zero draws none.

inkLow.description: The curvature magnitude (1 / fillet radius, in world units) at which the outline starts and the ridge and cavity terms saturate.

inkHigh.description: The curvature magnitude at which the outline saturates.

curvature.title: WorldRenderCurvature

keys.description: Named partial-record keys for this lighting section.

lighting.title: WorldRenderLighting

sky.description: The procedural sky — a gradient, sun disc, star field, and distance fog. Optional; an absent section renders the pinned two-stop gradient and 0.015 fog density bit-exactly, as before this section existed.

items.description: One sky layer. The $type string is the JSON discriminator.

anyOf.description: The colour gradient over elevation: piecewise-linear between stops, clamped to the end stops.

stops.description: Two to SdfLighting.MaxSkyStops stops, strictly ascending in elevation. A section key moves a stop by its authored name and may not add or remove one.

elevation.description: The direction's Y component this stop sits at, in [−1, 1].

color.description: BindableColor's grammar: the colour at this elevation. A gradient's authored stops require a color; omitted partial-record key leaves carry through the wrap.

name.description: The authored stop identity used by section keys.
The authored row identity used by section keys and source-preserving edits.

anyOf.title: WorldRenderSkyLayerGradient

anyOf.description: The exponential distance fog fading toward the sky gradient.

density.description: The density per world unit. Absent is the pinned density.

name.description: The authored row identity used by section keys and source-preserving edits.

anyOf.title: WorldRenderSkyLayerFog

anyOf.description: The visible sun disc — an additive highlight about one directional light's direction.

light.description: The Lights slot of a directional light. Absent is the shadow light, or the first directional when none shadows.

radius.description: The disc's angular half-radius in radians, in (0, π/2]. Absent is the engine default.
radius.title: BindableAngle

intensity.description: The peak additive brightness. Absent is zero, which draws nothing.

name.description: The authored row identity used by section keys and source-preserving edits.

anyOf.title: WorldRenderSkyLayerSunDisc

anyOf.description: The procedural star field: a deterministic per-cell hash over an octahedral sky projection.

density.description: The star grid's cell count per octahedral axis. Absent is the engine default.

brightness.description: The peak per-star brightness. Absent is zero, which draws nothing.

seed.description: The hash seed folded into every cell.

twinkle.description: Scintillation for a share of the stars. Optional; absent twinkles none.

share.description: The fraction of stars that twinkle, in [0, 1]. Zero twinkles none.

depth.description: How far a twinkling star dips below its steady brightness, in [0, 1].

rate.description: The fundamental scintillation rate in hertz.

twinkle.title: WorldRenderSkyTwinkle

name.description: The authored row identity used by section keys and source-preserving edits.

anyOf.title: WorldRenderSkyLayerStars

anyOf.description: The procedural cloud layer: a deterministic hashed-lattice noise on a plane above the camera, thresholded by coverage, drawn over the gradient, stars and sun disc and fading into the horizon.

coverage.description: The fraction of the sky the layer covers, in [0, 1]. Absent is zero.

softness.description: The width of a cloud's edge, in (0, 1]. Absent is the engine default.

scale.description: The size of one cloud cell in layer units (the layer sits at unit height). Absent is the engine default.

seed.description: The hash seed folded into the lattice.

color.description: BindableColor's grammar: the cloud colour. Absent is white.

drift.description: The layer's wind, in layer units per second along world X and Z, integrated on the tick clock. Absent holds still.

spin.description: The layer's rotation about the zenith in radians per second; positive is counter-clockwise seen from below. Absent is none.

curl.description: The Coriolis twist in radians at 45° elevation, falling off toward the horizon and the zenith. Positive winds counter-clockwise. Absent is none.
curl.title: BindableAngle

shear.description: The wind of the shaping field relative to the cloud field, in layer units per second. Absent holds the shapes.

name.description: The authored row identity used by section keys and source-preserving edits.

anyOf.title: WorldRenderSkyLayerClouds

items.title: WorldRenderSkyLayer

keys.description: Named partial-record keys for this sky section.

sky.title: WorldRenderSky

environment.description: The analytic studio-reflection softboxes and horizon gradient a GGX specular lobe reflects. Optional; absent (no softboxes, a black horizon) contributes nothing to the shaded color.

softboxes.description: The reflection softboxes, at most SdfLighting.MaxSoftboxes. Absent or empty contributes nothing.

items.description: One analytic studio-reflection softbox: a soft, angularly-extended highlight a GGX lobe catches in its mirror direction, widened by the surface's own roughness.

direction.description: From a reflecting surface toward the softbox, any nonzero length (normalized before upload).

size.description: The angular half-extent (width, height) the falloff widens by, both strictly positive.

color.description: BindableColor's grammar: the softbox's linear colour. Absent is white.

blur.description: Additional falloff softening, in the same units as Size. Absent is 0.

name.description: The authored softbox identity used by section keys.

items.title: WorldRenderSoftbox

horizon.description: The reflection horizon gradient. Absent is black — contributes nothing.

low.description: The ground-ward (direction.y = −1) colour. Absent is black.

high.description: The sky-ward (direction.y = 1) colour. Absent is black.

horizon.title: WorldRenderHorizon

keys.description: Named partial-record keys for this reflection environment.

environment.title: WorldRenderEnvironment

tonemap.description: The tonemap the root graph applies to the SDF scene: each view, as its place pass reconstructs it. The letterbox color, every pane (display-referred) and the HUD are never tonemapped. Optional; absent is None — the stylized shaded color, unchanged.
tonemap.title: WorldTonemap

farDistance.description: The far distance in world units: the depth at which every camera march ends — the far plane the renderer's fine march exits at, the reach of the beam's cone proofs, and the depth the fog and depth ramps are measured against. Geometry beyond it is never marched, so an infinite plane ends on a visible horizon curve at this depth unless the sky fog has absorbed it (render.sky.fogDensity). Optional; absent resolves to the engine's pinned 40 — exactly the value every world marched to before this field existed. Must lie within [MinFarDistance, MaxFarDistance]. Re-read on every definition revision (a world.row.set render lands on the next frame); world.budget echoes it with its derived costs.

keys.description: Named partial-record keys, compiled to ordinary typed values when the definition is prepared.
